name: fluxopro
description: FluxoPro — orquestrador de aprovações transversais (compras, reembolsos, contratações e férias)

scripts.dev: npm run dev -w server & npm run dev -w web
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w web && npm run build -w licitagov/server && npm run build -w licitagov/web
scripts.test: npm test -w server && npm test -w licitagov/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web && npm run typecheck -w licitagov/server && npm run typecheck -w licitagov/web
scripts.dev:licitagov: npm run dev -w licitagov/server & npm run dev -w licitagov/web
